ref.description: Stable opaque identifier, assigned by scripts/assign-ids.mjs, never changed or reused. Cite this, not the slug.

conditions.description: Applicability of the technique this claim is about, in a small controlled vocabulary an agent can filter on. Only on claims that set `technique`. Every value must be stated or clearly implied by the claim itself; absent fields mean the claim does not say.

effect.description: What this claim says the technique does to the capability: helps; narrows (helps only under the stated condition, or shifts rather than removes the failure); no-effect; hurts.

needs.description: What must be present for the technique to do its job. external-signal: a test result, compiler error, verifier output or environment outcome. executable-environment: code can be run. retrieval-corpus: documents or an index to retrieve from. fine-tuning-access: the weights can be trained. separate-model: a second model with different context. evaluation-split: a held-out set to gate changes. complete-mediation: the harness sees every side effect. raw-history: the unsummarised record stays retrievable.

helps_most.description: Which models gain most, where the claim compares. independent: the effect does not track model strength.

cost.description: Tokens, latency or training relative to one unaided attempt, where the claim says.

fails_when.description: The condition under which the technique stops helping or does harm, as the claim states it.

status.description: pending-review: ingested but not yet endorsed by a human. Browsable and linkable, but deliberately inert — it does not move a technique's standing, does not count toward the backtest, and is excluded anywhere a claim would otherwise carry weight. active: reviewed and held. superseded / retired: no longer current.

reviewed_by.description: Who has read this claim against its sources: agent:... for a model, human:... for a person. Absent means derived from submitted_by: a human submitter has reviewed it; an agent submitter means AI review only.
